## Architecture Overview

The `exporter.Settings` struct is defined in `opentelemetry-collector/exporter/exporter.go` (lines 33-45) with fields: `ID`, `TelemetrySettings`, `BuildInfo`, and `_ struct{}` for unkeyed literal prevention. Adding `RetryConfig RetrySettings` breaks all struct literal constructions including the critical `NewNopSettings()` test helper used across 100+ tests.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`exporter/exporter.go`** (lines 33-45) — Settings struct definition. Must add RetryConfig field.

### Struct Literal Construction Sites (Break)

- **`service/internal/graph/exporter.go`** (lines 54-58) — Constructs `exporter.Settings` in `buildComponent()`. CRITICAL break.
- **`service/internal/builders/builders_test/exporter_test.go`** (lines 216-220) — `createExporterSettings()` helper.
- **`exporter/exportertest/nop_exporter.go`** (lines 21-27) — `NewNopSettings()` test helper used across entire codebase. CRITICAL.
- **`exporter/exporter_test.go`** (lines 31-68) — Core exporter tests constructing Settings.

### Exporter Helpers (Receive Settings)

- **`exporter/exporterhelper/metrics.go`** — `NewMetrics()` accepts Settings.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/traces.go`** — `NewTraces()` accepts Settings.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/logs.go`** — `NewLogs()` accepts Settings.

### Contrib Exporter Factories (Receive Settings)

- **`exporter/fileexporter/factory.go`** — All create functions receive Settings.
- **`exporter/datadogexporter/factory.go`** — Complex factory with multiple create functions.
- **`exporter/loadbalancingexporter/factory.go`** — Has `buildExporterSettings()` modifying Settings.
- **`exporter/awss3exporter/factory.go`** — AWS S3 exporter factory.

### Jaeger

- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/exporters/storageexporter/factory.go`** — `createTracesExporter()` receives Settings.
